title: RefundFlow corpus manifest
description: Versioned specification for the reproducible, permission-safe local demonstration corpus. Governs a pinned external source (for example a public handbook), its licensing/attribution, the composed source records, and any deterministic synthetic adaptations. The validator enforces: pinned source metadata, explicit rights/effective dates, unique representations, and bounded planned selection.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this manifest schema (for example 1.0.0).

source.description: Pinned source revision metadata. The repository/revision are immutable anchors; the manifest is only rebuilt from this pinned revision.

repository.description: Public source repository URL (no credentials, no private/authenticated paths).

revision.description: Pinned source revision (for example a git commit SHA).

url.description: Canonical public page/index URL of the source collection.

company.description: Company the source belongs to (for example GitLab).

department.description: Primary department mapping for the source, with mapping confidence labeled.

media_type.description: Top-level normalized media type of the collected sources.

retrieval_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the pinned retrieval, for provenance and invalidation.

license.description: License and attribution for the corpus. Synthetic demonstration records are separately labeled; no public page is misrepresented as authentic company policy.

notice_file.description: Path to the license/NOTICE file (outside git unless redistribution is cleared).

rights.description: Explicit rights and retention. Effective dates are part of the manifest and invalidate cached answers without a global rebuild.

effective_from.description: Inclusive start date for these manifest terms.

effective_to.description: Exclusive end date for these manifest terms (null = always in force).

allowed_batches.description: Allowlisted source batches (paths/slugs) that may be ingested.

excluded_batches.description: Explicitly excluded source batches (for example personal profiles, recruiting material).

formed_by.description: Source records (originals and synthetic adaptations) that form the manifest.

representation_id.description: Stable, unique id for this representation within the manifest.

form.description: Whether this representation is an original source document or a synthetic adaptation.

media_type.description: Normalized media type of this representation.

source_hash.description: Raw content hash (sha256) of the original bytes.

normalized_hash.description: Hash of the normalized/paragraphed text used for chunking.

selections.description: Bounded planned selection counts, reported separately for originals and synthetic format variants.

original.description: Count of original source documents planned.

synthetic.description: Count of synthetic adaptation documents planned.

adaptive_variants.description: Deterministic synthetic adaptations with parent source hash and mutation recipe.

mutation_recipe.description: Label of the mutation (for example clause-number-edit, negation, full-replacement).

expected_changed_section_ids.description: Section ids expected to change under this recipe.

expected_answers.description: Optional expected-answer map for labeled evaluation.
